C226 ('Analyses and interprets graphs/data related with prevalence/containment and immunisation drives for several diseases') is a data/graph analysis skill under a different parent CLO96 and NCERT LO8 (analyses and interprets graphs/figures). With equal Class rank and no substantive evidence of deepening or dependency in either direction, symmetric conceptual coherence is the supported judgment rather than buildsTowards. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Class IX (rank 0) Indicators in the Gravitation chapter under the 'Moving things, People and Ideas' content domain, so the grain and scope match. C165 ('Explains the concept of relative density mathematically.') sits under CLO72/LO5, the explanatory strand establishing the mathematical meaning of relative density; C166 ('Calculates the unknown variable (weight, pressure, acceleration due to gravity, relative density) from a given data and assigns a proper SI unit to it.') sits under CLO73/LO6, the quantitative-calculation strand, and its Learning Components ('calculates the unknown variable ... from given data', 'assigns the proper SI unit ...') apply that quantity within a broader set of variables plus unit assignment. Direction is judged on substantive content because both coordinates rank equally; the reverse direction is not supported since calculation across several variables is the broader applied task.
